locus.output_selection: tensor output of XraySigLIP encoder layer 23 of 24 (B, 1024, 1024); this is the `hidden_states[-1]` that CLIPModel.forward passes to forward_resampler
locus.token_rule: all 1024 patch tokens of the 512x512 image (SigLIP has no CLS token, and the resampler reads every row)
locus.affected_branch: the single visual stream into the resampler
locus.bypasses: none on the consumed path: the tower's post_layernorm and its attention-pooling head are computed from this tensor and discarded, because the resampler reads the encoder's hidden-state tuple rather than the tower's last_hidden_state
